item.title: Strawberry, Coffee & Truffle: Seasonal Sips at LOYA, Taj Palace, New Delhi
item.description: LOYA continues to celebrate its well-loved VRIKSH cocktail programme, a thoughtfully curated menu that has been delighting guests for some time. Inspired by the journey from root to fruit and rooted in LOYA’s signature Paanch cocktail philosophy, VRIKSH presents a selection of seasonally suited cocktails that lend themselves beautifully to relaxed, indulgent evenings. The menu highlights warm, layered and comforting flavour profiles, crafted using seasonal ingredients and indigenous botanicals.
